bio: In the heart of Avignon, in a fine historical building – once a cloister – Mathieu Desmarest (Pollen) has swapped bistronomy for this brasserie, which is open seven days a week. The focus is on traditional French cuisine: devilled eggs, pâté en croûte, Burgundy snails or andouillette with mustard sauce, plus a weekly special (eg confit duck parmentier with aioli). Three concepts under one roof: brasserie, cocktail and tapas bar, and cheese bar. For fine weather, the leafy terrace in the courtyard is one of the city's loveliest spots.
